rows.question: What is the average age of the dogs who have gone through any treatments?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT AVG(dc.age_num) AS average_age
FROM (
  SELECT
    dog_id,
    age AS age_raw,
    CASE
      WHEN age IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN trim(age) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN age GLOB '-?[0-9]*.?[0-9]*' THEN CAST(age AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS age_num
  FROM Dogs
) dc
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT dog_id
  FROM Treatments
  WHERE dog_id IS NOT NULL
) t ON dc.dog_id = t.dog_id
WHERE dc.age_num IS NOT NULL

        ) AS REAL
      )
    END AS age_num
  FROM Dogs
),
dogs_with_treatments_cohort AS (

)
